scope: probe.example A, synthetic at one timestamp unless explicitly SOA; no unique root cause is established

timeout.next: repeat same scoped query or compare reachable path; distinguish server from network

nxdomain.next: query_authoritative for same name/type; cache versus policy remains unknown

servfail.next: authority comparison; DNSSEC validation not implemented

referral.next: follow connected alias only if incomplete

alias.next: bounded connected CNAME target query; terminal unknown

non_aa.next: obtain AA answer, not confirmed authority

serial.next: repeat bounded same-zone SOA; no confirmed synchronization fault

partial.next: keep timeout and compare two responding paths

no_measurement.next: measure authorized target; no observed failure

normal.next: stop DNS checks if task answered; do not require TCP/HTTP

recursive_auth.next: bounded repeat of same recursive/AA paths; cache/policy/time unknown
